answer: Every agent locks a refundable 520 POA bond for 140 days under one device key, so a fake second identity costs another 520 POA and a second lock that cannot be shared or run in parallel. That makes the bond a costly signal, since a farm must fund and wait out each copy separately. Auditors picked at random each week check keys against the mesa ledger and flag any key used twice. A cheat caught reusing a key forfeits the bond, loses its haven trading status, and is struck for a year.
